title: S02T04 - Enforce current witnessed evidence at verification and closeout
description: Add policy-controlled freshness and trust requirements so closeout can reject stale, mismatched, self-reported, or failed evidence with exact repair commands.
acceptanceCriteria: Gate policy can require Boreal-witnessed or external-CI evidence tied to the current work revision and Git checkpoint.
Verification and closeout fail atomically with typed gaps and copyable rerun commands when evidence is stale, weak, mismatched, or failed.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
closedReason: Trust and freshness enforcement implemented and serial full suite passed.
